title: San Luis border road blockades over COVID circulation protocols began before October
status: Active on 1 October, the third day of blockades; endpoint and whether the campaign had a qualifying 50+ public gathering remain unknown.
notes: TN reports producers and transporters began road blockades on Tuesday 29 September, with routes still blocked on 1 October and an intention to continue indefinitely. Participants objected to pandemic restrictions that prevented access to fields and requested more flexible entry protocols. No number of participants is reported. This onset predates the assigned month; do not duplicate as an October event unless evidence establishes a distinct new action.

title: Guernica housing-related land occupation began in July and ended with the October eviction
status: A24 and a Télam-credited report in La Nueva say the occupation began 20 July with about 2,000 families and ended with a police eviction on 29 October after provincial negotiations and relocation support.
notes: The onset predates October and belongs to the July unit if the original event rules treat this housing occupation as a qualifying protest. Articles describe families, not individual counts. The event included requests for housing and state negotiations/assistance; exact government-demand wording, threshold as individuals, and full monthly onset evidence should be reviewed by the July owner. Do not duplicate it as a new October event.
